Please read /papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/01_green_potential_resolvent/continuation-notes/15_TND_OG_E07_RESULTS_AND_MODEL_CHANGE_20261110.md, and continue with [B] TND-OG-B05 r2. Please also describe the current status of the project, high level results using formulas, and current decision points after performing the research.

Track your progress in the research progress folder, write research notes in the notes folder, and record chat history in the chat-histories folder. Please provide guidance for the continuation at the end of your research, and a continuation note for model changes, also mentioning the suggested continuation model in the chat.
I’ll read the continuation note and the project’s established results, then work through B05 r2 and record the findings, decision points, and handoff guidance in the investigation folders.

E07 accepted the deflation formulas, but left their practical inputs unproved: certified root clusters, a lower bound for the remaining factor, and the cost of obtaining both. I’ll use B05 r2 to develop a concrete acquisition design and compare it with direct exclusion using the same information. Any numerical field run will remain a separate task.

The most useful route appears to be a contour-based floor. If a disk’s zeros are all accounted for and the field stays away from zero on its boundary, the minimum-modulus principle gives an explicit lower bound for the deflated factor inside. I’m checking the resulting curvature bounds and acquisition costs, including what those same contours would already prove for direct exclusion.

The design now has an explicit conditional budget: 264 patches and 67,584 integration panels, provided the contour, root-location, and factor bounds pass. It also allows the field to be evaluated through local polynomials built from the literal theta source, so integration would not require a fresh source integral at every panel. These are design bounds, not measured theta results; the next task will test the missing acquisition steps.

The proof check found no correction needed in the new conditional bounds. If the full cover passes, the inherited tails and new allowances give an upper-endpoint error below \(0.017\); that does not establish a small value of \(J\). I’m finishing the handoff around three fixed patch tests and a direct contour test on the same target, with explicit stopping limits.

The research note, progress register, proof-author check, and model-change continuation are saved. The exact arithmetic, file links, and handoff input records passed verification. E08 is ready for a later Sol session; the full-cover calculation and favorable signed-value question remain open.

Completed **[B] TND-OG-B05 r2**. The [research note](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/01_green_potential_resolvent/notes/14_TND_OG_B05_R2_CONTOUR_CONDITIONING_AND_COST_20261110.md) supplies a concrete acquisition design. Its results are conditional and proof-author checked; no canonical field evaluation or new exclusion region was produced.

The Green branch still seeks a favorable signed bound for
\[
J(X)=\int_{\mathbb R}K(x-X)\log|F(x)|\,dx-P(X)+G(X,1),
\qquad K(t)=\frac1{16\cosh(\pi t/8)}.
\]
Here \(F=D_0H_0\), and \(P\) is the prime baseline. The positive-zero-sum interpretation gives the existing exclusion test
\[
J(X)<d\sin(\pi/8)\operatorname{sech}(\pi r/8).
\]

The project has established finite acquisition formulas and internally assessed their error accounting. E06 showed that its particular uniform-midpoint recipe exceeds the budget; E07 accepted the subsequent conditional deflation formulas. Separately, the inherited OC census gives
\[
J(1500)<\frac{291}{65536}+2^{-157}<\frac1{200},
\]
but that reuses stronger zero-location information and adds no exclusion coverage.

The new r2 contribution is an explicit way to acquire the previously unspecified regular-factor floor. If all \(n\) zeros in a disk of radius \(A\) lie within radius \(b<A\), and the boundary modulus is at least \(m_\partial>0\), then
\[
H_0(z)=\prod_{j=1}^n(z-z_j)U(z)
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
|U(z)|\ge\frac{m_\partial}{(A+b)^n}.
\]
Complete root counts are essential. Together with a complex-disk bound \(\mu\le|\widetilde U|\le V\), this gives
\[
|(\log|\widetilde U|)''|
\le\frac{2\log(V/\mu)}{(A-\ell)^2}.
\]

Under the explicit, **still-unmeasured** gates, the design uses **264 patches and 67,584 integration panels**. Including inherited tails, it would give
\[
0\le J_{\rm up}-J<0.017.
\]
That is an acquisition-error bound, **not** a bound \(J<0.017\).

The next decisions are whether those contour, root-location and factor bounds can be acquired affordably, and whether direct exclusion already resolves the same target using the same source. A successful direct test would make further Green computation calibration or observable reuse.

The progress register, notes, assessment and chat history are updated; capture of this final reply is queued.

**Next: [E] TND-OG-E08 — GPT-6.1 Sol**, at your selected effort: check the formulas, then execute three fixed patch acquisitions and one matched direct contour test. The [model-change continuation and pasteable prompt](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/01_green_potential_resolvent/continuation-notes/16_TND_OG_B05_R2_RESULTS_AND_MODEL_CHANGE_20261110.md) contain the bounded contract. This routing follows the repository’s B/E policy and [official model guidance](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/model-selection).
